_readme: THE menu. Edit this file, then run `python3 tools/build.py`. It rewrites the home page menu + structured data, order.html, llms.txt and the printable PDF. n8n reads this file live from https://georgianbakedgoods.com/data/menu.json to price orders. Never reuse an id: set "available": false to take an item off the menu (it stays here so its number is never given to a different item).
